rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f2441 (2025) p. 1, Part I: "If you have more than three care providers, see the instructions and check this box"; i2441 p. 2, Line 1: "If you have more than three care providers, check the box above line 1 and attach a statement to your return with the required information." The question "Did you receive dependent care benefits?" is a separate entry below line 1 (f2441 p. 1, "No ▶ Complete only Part II below. Yes ▶ Complete Part III on page 2 next."). The candidate transcribes the box as the benefits answer (f2441.benefits), which is a different entry of the form. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/f2441.json`, pass 045801c274b5; 1,702 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 319 partial records; 2,521 comparisons): 2,402 of 2,521 agree; differences 79 value, 38 project-unknown, 2 candidate-unknown; on returns the full interview completes: 23 value; witnesses enumerated with the cap lifted (scratch /tmp/adj/tr/eicwork/full/f2441.json). The 23 completed value differences are of the two shapes: 21 returns with dependent care benefits and one care provider (project false, candidate true; e.g. classm.f2441.1, classm.f2441.3, stage15.f2441.s4, stage19.mut.dc_box10_spouse_only) and 2 returns with four providers and no benefits (classm.f2441.2, stage15.mut.f2441_four_providers: project true, candidate false); f2441.provider_count and f2441.benefits evaluated on all 23. The source supports the project on each. The other differences are on incomplete or refused records. Gate-wave check: f2441.line1_box gives the same value in HEAD and the working tree on all 23 witnesses and every completed return (1,702 fixtures and 500 generated returns evaluated in both trees); it differs only on 8 refused records, false in HEAD and unknown in the working tree where the choose waits on f2441.filing. Project stands.

Project stands.

Ruling: representation after correction BUG-0119; the two trees differ only by the per-person field dependent.dc_line2d versus dependent.dc_paid, an unconditional copy, with identical qualifying-person filters. After BUG-0119 the existing f2441.paid_2026 input asks for every other qualified 2025 incurred expense regardless of payment date, including unpaid expenses. Together the per-person amounts and that nonduplicating supplement meet i2441 (2025) p. 5 Line 16. The prior ruling incorrectly treated a question limited to 2026 payments as covering every payment date; that premise was false and is corrected here, not reused as evidence that the old input was sound. The saved payment-year witness records the former $4000 taxable-benefit overstatement.
